<!-- Modified by lavinhoque33, 2026-11-20. -->
## YouTube – Fullscreen ([#66](https://github.com/lavinhoque33/revanced-patches/issues/66))

- At **Default** video scale, RVX leaves YouTube’s fullscreen animation alone. Leaving Stretch or Zoom restores only the transforms RVX applied.
- Fullscreen overlay buttons now update their alignment after layout changes instead of searching the player on every draw.
- In dark theme, YouTube can choose its native elevated-player layout again. The light-theme readability fix stays in place.

On a Moto Edge Plus 2023 with YouTube 21.45.90, both this prerelease and v1.44.0 showed the action row and More videos when the controls were revealed. The Realme 9 Pro frame skips and delayed first appearance of the row are not confirmed fixed.
